description: The Geography of Australia's Digital Industries is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO). A report produced by the CSIRO and the Tech Council of Australia examining the geographical concentration of digital technology clusters across Australia. It also includes the online CSIRO Tech Industry Map, which allows users to view and interact with data showing the concentration of technology workers at a range of geographic levels such as Local Government Areas (LGAs) and Statistical Area Level 2 (SA2). Coverage is Australia, 2011 to 2021; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-21. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY-NC (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
